steps.message:
FILES: rich/highlighter.py:101
ROOT CAUSE: The regular expression for URLs in `rich/highlighter.py` does not include the tilde (`~`) character in its allowed character set.
CHANGE: Add `~` to the character class of the URL regex: `r"(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#]*)"` becomes `r"(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#~]*)"`.
TEST: tests/test_highlighter.py

I have updated the URL regular expression in `rich/highlighter.py` to include the tilde (`~`) character, allowing URLs containing tildes to be correctly highlighted.

To verify the fix, you can run the highlighter tests:
`pytest tests/test_highlighter.py`
